- Overestimate prices after strong positive sentiment spikes; reduce forecast peak values by 5–10% if sentiment > 0.67 in recent days.
- Underestimate prices after strong negative sentiment dips; raise forecast lows by 5–10% if sentiment < -0.33 in recent days.
- Model tends to overreact to recent price volatility; dampen forecast slope after 3–5 consecutive high/low swings.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 2–5% unless sentiment is strongly bullish.
- Overshoot correction: if forecast exceeds true outcome by >5% for 3+ consecutive days, reduce next forecast by 3–7% to avoid overcorrection.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts often overestimate early in the cycle; adjust downward by 1–3% if sentiment is neutral or slightly bullish.
